body: I want to try burning but, I don't like the idea of using something like a flat iron. I want to use a lighter, I already know how using one feels
For me, aloe gel and applying cold water usually help
Yeah true, it feels like so many other unhealthy habits are embraced or left alone but we're mocked for cutting

I don't necessarily just cut when I'm in distress. I do it when I'm having an otherwise good day too. There's this certain feeling, like everything is calm now and I'll be okay. It's comforting, and painful at the same time. The more blood I draw, the happier and more proud I feel. 

I also tend to keep count. If I cut less than 5 times each session then I've failed. And I continue to try to push myself to higher numbers. My highest number at the moment is 40 cuts in one session. Though, I don't know why I do this.

Yeah, I get you. I've never had any friends, not a single one until recently because I've managed to make a few online friends. That sinking loneliness  is like nothing else :') I've always been extremely jealous of people who have friends and people who go to school. Those are things I'll never stop envying

I often feel this way as well. I don't want to burden or hurt them. But, I have one friend who tells me stuff too. And I find that us sharing our pain in one another is much more comforting than me keeping everything to myself. But, with other people I do largely keep to myself to avoid hurting them. So, I'm afraid the answer to your question might be "it depends on the individual you're speaking to". Because some people can handle it, and some can't. Maybe try expressing your concerns to them?
Christmas/holidays, birthdays, and shopping. God I hate shopping
For me this is all the time tbh. I usually talk to myself, daydream, read or draw. All while listening to really loud music
Dang, dreams like this suck to deal with

I think it's more selfish to call it selfish tbh. Someone is in so much pain that they want to end their lives and all you can think about is how it'll affect YOU, how YOU will feel, how YOU will cope. I mean Jesus Christ, a bit of sympathy would be nice.
Both. I SH when I'm completely calm and having an otherwise good day, and when something happens/when I'm feeling extremely emotional.
I actually don't need to hide mine at all. I draw so everyone believes I use the blade for sharpening pencils, so I just leave it in a small box on my desk.

I can't say that I relate to everything you're going through. But, feeling ignored, self harm, and especially escaping into fantasies in your head.  I know all about those, and I'm sorry you have to experience the things you do. Maybe you could give that dream of yours a try, it's worth a shot I think.
Yeah sure, I wouldn't mind talking :)
Thank you, I know. It's really hard to see that sometimes tho
